over the same 5 daily nets, from the latest back: each net sell -1; a net buy stops it (latest buy -> 1); zero stops it (Worker marketRisk.ts:203-211)

daily net = sum over symbols with both values of foreign net shares x close / 1e8 (100M TWD); sum of the last 5 sessions; null if fewer than 5 sessions or any of them has symbol coverage < 0.90. Why 0.90: in capture finlab-v4-daily-20261030 about 116 ETF/preferred symbols a day are vendor null in foreign_net.parquet, so median coverage is 0.945; 0.90 passes 723/727 days and 715/723 5-day windows and still rejects the 0.78 days (0.95 passed 79/723 windows)
features.universe: every symbol with a close and a foreign net value, ETFs included
features.worker_difference: proxy: the Worker sums the official all-market amount table; shares x close is not the traded price and excludes foreign dealers
